verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְו‍ֹתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth the LORD, That delighteth greatly in His commandments.

verses.he: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house; And his merit endureth for ever.

verses.he: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֖וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
verses.en: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, Gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.he: טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, That ordereth his affairs rightfully.

verses.he: כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.en: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

verses.he: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is stedfast, trusting in the LORD.

verses.he: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he gaze upon his adversaries.

verses.he: פִּזַּ֤ר׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever; His horn shall be exalted in honour.

verses.he: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.
